name: io.github.dawnwood-ai/demusic
title: demusic
description: Remove background music AI video models bake into clips; keep dialogue and SFX.

environmentVariables.name: DEMUSIC_SEPARATOR
environmentVariables.description: demucs (local, needs demusic[demucs]) | fal (needs FAL_KEY) - default demucs

environmentVariables.name: FAL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: your fal.ai key when DEMUSIC_SEPARATOR=fal

environmentVariables.name: DEMUSIC_FFMPEG
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffmpeg (default: ffmpeg on PATH)
